44: That he handled - From the hands of the shopkeeper and gave to them, that now he is [directly] supplying them with the prohibited, and this is not because of the later payment, rather he acquires it with Meshicha (handling of the goods), and it transpires that he has taken possession of wine used for libation and given it to drink to his workers. But the house of R. Yannai when they take possession of the produce it is at a permitted time, and when they subsequently compensate at the time Shevi'it is forbidden it is no longer considered an exchange that effects a transfer [of the  restrictions]
Go - Implies that he is not going with them (to the shop).
